text: Hi! Let’s find the right voice for you. I’ll practice some things I like to say while you listen. Let me try this one out. You have one new message. Here’s another one: Your timer is set for one minute. Now for some directions: At the next stop sign, turn right. How about some facts? Otters have been known to hold hands while sleeping so they don’t drift apart. Let’s go around again.
